findings.evidence: Uses phase-specific candidate mechanisms rather than inferring total pause from allocation or mortality; preserves collector-specific age/sizing policies and competing CPU/memory explanations.

Java 25 API requires extremely short non-callback critical functions. Tagged CallingSequence chooses native transition based on critical status rather than heap access; x86 stub conditionally performs that transition. Thus critical(false) is not an ordinary native binding.

Oracle's JDK 25 guide says larger-or-equal half a region, but tagged HotSpot 25.0.3 G1CollectedHeap.hpp explicitly uses strict greater-than and explains its TLAB boundary. The skill already follows that implementation. Do not introduce an equality error from the overview guide.
